case.summary: On 2016-11-22 17:27:07, card C11891-K1 associated with customer C11891 attempted an online transaction (ID 3478782) of $292.36 for product C. This transaction triggered real-time scoring at 0.79 and exhibited a significant deviation (z=9.7) from the card's 35-transaction baseline average of $44.66, yielding a calibrated fraud probability of 0.92. Upon inquiry, the customer confirmed that they did not authorize the purchase and remained in physical possession of the card. The incident was classified as card-not-present fraud under case HHG-002, and card C11891-K1 was blocked.
